scope: All seventeen canonical resources classified as monitors or research publications in the current public resource registry.
boundary: This register distinguishes two manually maintained monitors from nine dated demonstrations and six read-only research publications. A passing record proves checked-in source, cadence, freshness, publication, and rendered-boundary contracts within the repository; it does not prove unattended retrieval, real-time alerts, comprehensive coverage, external integrations, professional correctness, or independent browser execution.
